client-onboarding.summary: yourAICIV delivery engine: stand up a client's business system (funnel, CRM, dashboard, email automations, store, blog, affiliates, booking; Stripe default) from apps/client-starter via Intake -> Provision -> Customize -> Verify -> Hand Off.
client-onboarding.fires_from: CLIENT-ONBOARDING gate (.claude/CLAUDE.md), wake-up-protocol Step 6.5, on request

partner-notifications.summary: Email the reseller partner (config/partner.json notify_emails) once per event: born, first conversation, WOW build shipped, trial day 6 / expired / converted, self-detected health problems, delivery-engine business alerts. Thin sender: tools/partner_notify.py; queues to an outbox when email is not provisioned.
partner-notifications.fires_from: you (first conversation, WOW shipped, health) + session_start hook, trial_gate hook, tools/watchdog.sh tick, apply_trial_profile convert, delivery engine notify_owner

notes: Skills registry grows as skills are created. See .claude/skills/ for SKILL.md files.
